records.title: Plastic Parks in Maharashtra
details: a to d: These 10 Plastic Parks are at various stages of implementation, and the Department is focusing on successful completion and operationalization of these 10 parks.

records.title: Use of Nano Urea.
details:
e): A Phase-II study by NPC has also been signed on 14.11.2025 for evaluating the extent of replacement of Conventional Urea by Nano Urea. The Phase-II study will be conducted at a cost of Rs. 61.52 lakh.
f): 2 new Nano Urea production units are planned, one at Trombay by RCF with an annual capacity of 5 crore bottles, and another at Deoghar, Jharkhand by IFFCO with a capacity of 6 crore bottles per year.

records.title: Conversion of AIIMS, Delhi INTO Leading Medical Research & Practice Institute
details: a to f: To create a roadmap to transform AIIMS, New Delhi, into a premier institution for Medical Research and Practice, a Committee led by Dr. V.K. Paul, Member of NITI Aayog, has been formed.
